rules.inputs: Open only the locked archive, source pointers, public prompts and P2-16 candidate index. Reviewer data is inaccessible to the runner. Use inherited image-space D2 and D3 when their source comparison endpoints are visible, record missing endpoints; diagnostics do not create new M7 nominations.
rules.controls: A locked static graphic fixture and the same graphic with a source-only colored pulse. Both are processed by the existing 2 fps supplemental nomination procedure. The exact pulse range appears only in the fixture and scoring stage.
rules.T0: Ordinary coverage. One midpoint neighborhood of one coarse cadence per consecutive D6 anchor gap. Enumerate every consecutive D6 anchor gap. No visual trigger.
rules.T1: Evaluate all frozen D2 two-endpoint roots. A local destination footprint and both readable qualified anchors are required; record but do not gate on the additional T3 comparability diagnostics.
rules.T2: Add changes in D3 nearest-context-edge distance when existing comparison support, transformed edge proximity, and the same candidate spatial footprint allow a local comparison. Physical identity/contact remain unknown.
rules.T3: Add inherited D4/D5. Camera, brightness, registration and quality are competitive explanations. Reject local-state/relative queries without comparable endpoints. D4 registration and unregistered D5 checks are viewpoint diagnostics, not local object support. D5 visibility-gap endpoints can request a separate ambiguity check. Opposite/duplicate nominations for the same comparison root are one trigger.
rules.T4: Exactly the T3 proposals and intervals, augmented with frozen object/region and frame-internal edges intersecting the measured region. No semantics on B or windows; do not infer new action triggers.
rules.T5: Same physical gates, plus a finite gap question and explicit alternative interpretation from each eligible kind. Review each independently supported time region and eligible source bracket. Pure coverage remains separately attributed; do not follow long chains. Explicit between-samples directive is a separate non-automatic entrance, available in all arms only when the public prompt contains it. No arm count limits.
rules.windows: D2 and D3 use the open A–C interval; D4/D5 use their documented witness interval. T0 midpoint probes have their own scope. T5 may use independent D6 partitions to open earliest and latest eligible state anchors in each partition. Queries use a common source-relative 8 Hz clock and group repeated physical frame reads without discarding other proposal references.
rules.feedback: Measure new B images against comparable anchors in the C region; detect a distinct crop sample or geometric/exposure explanation, retain unknown for ambiguity, review-only and no-new. Scores from E0 are independent and are not consumed to finish the route.
rules.termination: Finish all finite proposed brackets and pending pages, or save a technical interruption with its pending jobs. Unanswered claims and unobserved intervals remain explicitly bounded. Do not assert action, identity, full visibility or whole-source absence.
